SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KADT_KEP WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_5 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'EFMC' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(TARGET,' ') AS PLANT, ISNULL(B.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(B.KEY_2,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(ITEM_VAT,0) AS ITEM_VAT, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(B.TARGET,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(ORD_SABUNNM,' ') AS ORD_SABUNNM, ISNULL(REQ_NO,' ') AS REQ_NO, ISNULL(REQ_SEQ,' ') AS REQ_SEQ, ISNULL(REQ_NO,' ')+'-'+ISNULL(REQ_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(REQ_SABUN,' ') AS REQ_USER_ID, ISNULL(TARGET,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(REQ_SABUNNM,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_BUSEONM,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(CUSTCODE,' ') AS CUSTCODE, ISNULL(REMARKS,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEP_BALJOO_INFO_V A, KADT_KEP B WHERE B.DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND B.KEY_5 in (' ','T') AND B.TARGET *= A.DELY_TO_LOCATION AND B.KEY_1 *= A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND B.KEY_2 *= A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND B.KEY_1 *= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' ORDER BY KEY_1, CAST(KEY_2 AS INT)
UPDATE PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_5 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_5 in (' ','T')
